name: Alustra® Architectural Roller Shades
description: The innovative form of Alustra® Architectural Shades infuses a soft yet structural beauty at the window. Sophisticated fabrics combined with a unique linear design.

benefits.text:
Innovative Shade Structure
Combine the beauty of a traditional Roman shade with the minimal aesthetic of a roller shade. The unique, 
architectural construction of a fabric wrapped curved batten adds dimension and structure with a modern vibe.
Versatile Fabric Opacity
Exclusive textural fabrics in distinctive hues are available from sheer to semi-opaque providing light 
control and privacy options.
22
Benefits
Innovative Shade Structure
Combine the beauty of a traditional Roman shade with the minimal aesthetic of a roller shade. The unique, 
architectural construction of a fabric wrapped curved batten adds dimension and structure with a modern vibe.
Superior Functionality
Style meets performance, the proprietary Custom Clutch is available with cassette or bracket only. Elevate the 
style and design with the Exclusive Alustra Metal Custom Clutch Bracket and metal bead chain option. Available 
in Brushed Nickel and Bronze Shimmer. 
PowerView® Automation
PowerView® Automation provides the ultimate in home automation allowing you to control every shade with the 
touch of a button.

Reverse Roll Recessed: Top Panel Variation
With the Reverse Roll Recessed option, the top panel height and batten 
placement will vary based on the length of shade. All other panels and 
batten positions on the shade will be equal.
Reverse Roll Shade rolls off the front of the headrail 
creating uniform batten and panel spacing from  
top to bottom.
Once fully lowered the shade automatically kicks 
back into position reducing space between shade 
and window.
